title: A Bridging Study of the SYN023 on Healthy Adult Subjects
brief_summary: The Phase I bridging clinical trial is to evaluate on the safety, pharmacokinetics (PK), pharmacodynamics (PD) and ADA of a single intramuscular injection of recombinant anti-rabies human monoclonal antibody injection (SYN023) alone or combined with rabies vaccine in healthy subjects. The study primary purpose was to compare the pharmacokinetics (PK) between U.S and China subjects, therefore to lay a foundation for the follow-up clinical trials. The secondary purpose was to evaluate the PK, PD, Safety and ADA of SYN023 in Chinese Healthy subjects and compare with that of U.S. subjects.
